title: figma-dev-tools custom component mappings
description: Schema for project-level custom UI component mappings at .figma-dev/components.json. Custom rules take priority over built-in shadcn/ui, Ant Design and Element Plus mappings. Invalid files are reported (i18n) and ignored; code generation continues with built-in mappings.

components.description: Custom component rules evaluated before built-in tables (first keyword hit wins).

library.description: Target library. Omit to make the rule library-agnostic (applies to whichever library is detected).

importPath.description: Import source: package name ("antd", "element-plus") or alias path ("@/components/...").

keywords.description: Case-insensitive node-name keywords (Chinese or English), e.g. ["button", "按钮"].

usageExample.description: Optional usage snippet shown in suggestions (JSX or Vue template).

suggestedProps.description: Static props suggested on every match (values must be string or boolean).
